rules.cite: Berkeley Municipal Code § 13.76.110A; Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.coverage_text: All residential rental properties subject to Berkeley rent stabilization.

exemptions.description: Tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

all.tenancy_conditions: tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025
rent set pursuant to Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act

key_values.name: CPI adjustment formula
key_values.text: 65% of the increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) for All Urban Consumers in the Bay Area during the period from July 1, 2024 - June 30, 2025

rules.quote: the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may increase permanent rent ceilings by 1.0%, effective no earlier than January 1, 2026. Tenants whose tenancy began on or after January 1, 2025 and whose rents were set pursuant to the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act may not have their rents adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.title: 2026 Annual General Adjustment
